[Section] Baseline Experiments ::: Multilingual BERT Baseline ::: Results
[source_id=81] Table TABREF36 shows the results for the cross-lingual setting. M-Bert performs consistently better than the majority class baselines. Even the zero-short performance in Italian, while significantly lower than the supervised scores, is much better than the target-wise majority class baseline.
[source_id=82] Results for the cross-target setting are given in Table TABREF37. Similar to the cross-lingual setting, M-Bert performs worse in a cross-target setting but easily surpasses the majority class baselines. Furthermore, the cross-question score of M-Bert is slightly lower than the cross-topic score.
